payload.title: Surfable site: concepts, citation links and a page for every Reference
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-09: keep readers on our site. (1) A Concepts row on story pages, above the references. (2) The end-of-page citation list links to our own post when a published post is based_on that Reference, else to our own Reference page, else out; every outside link carries the Lucide external-link icon and opens in a new tab. (3) A public page for each accepted Reference: our summary, source and date, credited image, concepts, the stories based on or citing it, and a clear read-the-original link. (4) Later, optional: wide-screen split view with the original, only for sources that allow framing (record frameability at ingestion), never the default. Measured 2026-11-09 (MoM): 54 articles, 68 posts; 36/54 articles and 25/68 posts link a public concept page via mentions/related_to relations (not front matter); 35 public concept pages vs 196 accepted entities; 827 accepted References, 388 with a summary, 229 with concept links; 248 distinct cited URLs, 162 match an accepted Reference, only 24 of those have a post based on them.
